camel_example: aliyun resourcecenter ExecuteSQLQuery --region cn-hangzhou --Expression 'SELECT * FROM resources LIMIT 100;'
description_en: Queries the resources that the current account has permission to access by using SQL
description_zh: 使用SQL查询当前账号下有权限访问的资源
kebab_example: aliyun resourcecenter execute-sql-query --expression 'SELECT * FROM resources LIMIT 100;' --region cn-hangzhou
name: ExecuteSQLQuery

parameters.help_en:
The SQL statement to be executed.

The length of the SQL statement must be less than 2,000 characters.

For more information about SQL syntax, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2539395.html
parameters.help_zh:
待执行SQL语句。

待执行SQL语句长度小于2000个字符。

关于SQL语法的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2539395.html
parameters.name: expression

parameters.help_en:
The search scope.

Set the value to a resource group ID to search for resources in the resource group.

For more information about how to obtain a resource group ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/158855.html
parameters.help_zh:
搜索的范围。

取值为资源组ID，表示搜索资源组中的资源。

关于如何获取资源组ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/158855.html
parameters.name: scope

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of entries per page.

Valid values: 1 to 1000.

Default value: 1000
parameters.help_zh:
每页的最大数据条数。

取值范围：1~1000。

默认值：1000
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en:
The token used to query the next page of results.

If the total number of returned entries exceeds the value of MaxResults, the results are truncated. You can use NextToken to query the next page
parameters.help_zh:
查询返回结果下一页的令牌。

当返回结果数据总条数超过`MaxResults`限制，则数据会被截断，您可以使用`NextToken`查询下一页数据
parameters.name: next_token

MaxResults.description_en: The maximum number of entries per page

NextToken.description_en: The token used to query the next page of results
NextToken.description_zh: 查询返回结果下一页的令牌
